title: Constitutional Capitalism — A Living Constitutional Philosophy

scope_shift.current_framing: A living constitutional philosophy supported by durable public systems — more durable than a book alone.
scope_shift.book_role: Introduction and portable expression of the philosophy; not the whole operating system.
scope_shift.evolution_framing: The project defines not only what Constitutional Capitalism is, but how Constitutional Capitalism itself should evolve.

integrity_rules_observed: Do not move modeling or legal review forward without doing the work
Stop designing the future platform while Phase 2 proof remains open
Phase 9 depends on Phase 2 evidence quality

canonical_honesty_state.phase_2: PARTIAL — primary question: What can we prove?
canonical_honesty_state.phase_3_plus: Not started under official phases.json numbering
canonical_honesty_state.note: Official phase IDs remain those in data/project/phases.json. Narrative layers below describe program vision; they do not renumber or complete later phases.

program_vision_layers.honesty: Official Phase 5 includes modeling among testing/opposition deliverables; progress remains 0% until real models exist.

primary_benchmark.name: Human Flourishing Index
primary_benchmark.question: Did human life improve?
primary_benchmark.policy_question: Does this measurably increase human flourishing?

architectural_doctrines.title: Constitutional Symmetry (architectural doctrine)
architectural_doctrines.note: Not a new CC-PRIN-*. Captures how the project governs itself.
architectural_doctrines.text: The framework itself should operate according to the same values it advocates for society.

mappings.project_practice: every accepted change has a rationale
expertise is welcomed through structured review
claims advance through proof, not popularity
AI analyzes, reviewers critique, humans decide
every revision strengthens rather than destabilizes the system

architectural_freeze_point.milestone: Architecture has transitioned from invention to stewardship.
architectural_freeze_point.success_question_now: Can we prove what we already have?

founding_steward.rule: BETA collaborator — exercise the entire governance and research system before external reviewers. Not merely 'author.'
responsibilities: ensuring the system behaves as designed

domain_stewards.core_question: Has this domain been treated fairly, rigorously, and accurately?
domain_stewards.independence_ask: Will you independently review this work within your area of expertise and tell us where it is strong, where it is weak, and where it requires further research?

three_kinds_of_truth.title: Design judgment
three_kinds_of_truth.question: Assuming our values are accepted, what institutional design best advances them?
